item.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by Location / TIER 2

request.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by Location / TIER 2

description.content:
**What are the airports closest to the location?**

At the moment airports having both ICAO and IATA code and flight schedules are present available only.

*Returns:* A list of airports found within the specified radius around the specified location.

query.description: (Required) Latitude location coordinate in decimal format (between -90 and 90)
(Required) Longitude location coordinate in decimal format (between -180 and 180)
(Required) Radius of search around specified location in kilometers (max. 1000 km)
(Required) Maximum number of airports to be returned (max. 250)
If set to true, will only return airports which have flight data (scheduled or live) available. Default = false.

item.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by IP Address Geolocation / TIER 2

request.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by IP Address Geolocation / TIER 2

description.content:
**What are the airports closest to the customer, based on their IP address?**
**What are the airports closest to the location determined (geo-located) by a IP address?**

This endpoint determines the location by the IP address provided and then returns the list of the nearest airports
in the same way as `Search airports by location` endpoint does. 

Please note:
* IP geo-location is not a precise method and it determines an approximate location only.
* At the moment airports having both ICAO and IATA code and flight schedules are present available only.

*Returns:* A list of airports found within the specified radius around the location approximated (geo-located) from the specified IP address.

query.description: (Required) A valid public IP v4 address
(Required) Radius of search around specified location in kilometers (max. 1000 km)
(Required) Maximum number of airports to be returned (max. 250)
If set to true, will only return airports which have flight data (scheduled or live) available. Default = false.

item.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by Free Text / TIER 2

request.name: AeroDataBox Search Airports by Free Text / TIER 2

description.content:
At the moment airports having both ICAO and IATA code and flight schedules are present available only.

*Returns:* List of airports with names and city names (and IATA/ICAO code, if enabled) matching the search term.

query.description: (Required) Search query (min. 3 non whitespace characters length)
Maximum number of airports to be returned (max. 250, defaut = 10)
If set to true, will only return airports which have flight data (scheduled or live) available. Default = false.

If set to true, will attempt to interpret short words within the search query as IATA or ICAO code
and prioritize exact matches by these codes (they will appear higher than others). 
Otherwise, the search by code will be completely excluded (only the name of an airport or its city will be searched). 
Default = true.
